description: Rules text to the tokens a card makes, for offline token-art downloads. Read by apps/ios/MagicMobileTests/ParityGoldenTests.swift (NativeTokenRules) and apps/android/core/src/test/kotlin/io/magicmobile/android/game/ParityGoldenTest.kt (TokenRules). Text is the bundled catalogue's raw rules text. power/toughness appear only when printed as numbers; colors only when named (colorless is []).
